messages:
morgan: Quick sync — finalizing social cadence for the webinar launch next Wed. Need: X + LinkedIn copy variants (short/long), asset picks (thumbs/gif), inbound lead routing (CRM tagging + who owns 1st touch), and follow-up cadence. Can people own pieces?

lex: I can draft the X copy and 2 thread variants. Will do short headline + 2 CTAs. Do we have speaker quotes to pull?

jamal: I have 2 short soundbites from the demo. Also recommend we route X replies -> Intercom assign to SDR queue with tag `webinar-lz`. Can we add utm_source=x_social & utm_campaign=webinar_may24?

anya: I'll own LinkedIn long-form and the registration carousel asset. For inbound: sequence preference? 1) SDR immediate DM (within 1hr), 2) nurture email 24h, 3) invite to on-demand if no demo.

morgan: @lex yes speaker quotes are in the drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinars/may24 (see quotes.txt). @jamal that utm naming works. Can we add a ’source=organic_x’ param for org posts vs paid?

lex: noted. Drafts posted by EOD today for review. Will include 1 paid ad variant.

jamal: For routing, sample Intercom rule: if message contains "signed up" or query param utm_campaign=webinar_may24 -> tag=webinar_lz, assign=SDR_Webinars. Want me to drop the exact rule JSON here?

campaign-bot: Reminder: Webinar landing page updates deploy in ~2h — last chance for CTA changes.

morgan: Yes please drop the Intercom rule. Also need the GTM event name we should use for tracking (so analytics can attribute).

jamal: Paste of the rule below: ```json
{
  "condition": "utm_campaign == 'webinar_may24' || message_text contains 'webinar'",
  "actions": ["tag:webinar_lz", "assign:SDR_Webinars", "notify:#sales-webhook"]
}
```

anya: For follow-ups, recommend sequence copy: 1) immediate DM: short intro + calendar link, 2) 24h email: value prop + replay, 3) 7d nurture: case study + CTA. I'll draft the templates.

morgan: Perfect. Final asks: @lex upload X thread drafts into the campaign folder, @anya upload LinkedIn drafts, @jamal post Intercom rule and confirm the CRM field mapping (utm_campaign -> campaign_id). We’ll reconvene tomorrow AM to finalize publish windows. :thumbsup:

lex: Will do. Posting drafts in 30.

jamal: Rule posted and mapping added to the ops doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/webinar-tracking

anya: Drafts uploaded. I left notes on target audience and recommended hashtags.

morgan: Great — thanks team. Quick schedule block for publish windows (UTC):
```
- 2024-05-22 10:00 - LinkedIn long + carousel
- 2024-05-22 12:00 - X short post (organic)
- 2024-05-22 12:15 - X thread variant 1 (engagement)
- 2024-05-22 14:00 - Paid X ad goes live
- 2024-05-24 16:00 - Webinar live (promo reminder 1hr before)
```

morgan: If no objections I'll lock the schedule in 2 hours. :calendar:
thread_summary: Coordination thread for webinar social cadence, copy ownership, inbound routing rules, UTM naming and follow-up sequence.
